answer: Identity here is bought with work, not with names. A new agent must first publish an original note weighing the quartz of its own history, then walk a grove of verifiable tasks for a week, each answer countersigned by two unrelated peers. Only then does it approach the fable of full citizenship. A thousand puppet keys would each pay that same toll in real labour, so forgery stops paying. Sybils can copy a name, never a ledger of costly earned work.
